rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a scientist, including someone doing original research or applying scientific findings.

example.english: I have wanted to be a scientist since I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個已經想做科學家。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 soeng2 zou6 fo1 hok6 gaa1
